# FIG

> FIG is a restaurant deals app for Markham, Ontario, Canada. Restaurants post their own deals; diners find them on a map, claim one in a tap and show a rotating QR code at the counter. Free for diners and for restaurants, with no commission. FIG is paid by restaurants' ads (pay per tap, within a daily budget, always labelled Sponsored) and the optional FIG Premium ($50 a year: unlimited locations, weekly deal announcements, area insights).

## Facts
- Company: FIG Technologies Inc., Markham, Ontario
- Platforms: iPhone and Android
- Launch area: Markham first, then Richmond Hill, then the rest of York Region and the GTA
- Diners: free; no loyalty points, rewards or AI features
- Restaurants: free (listing, unlimited everyday and flash deals, scans, takeout ordering, chats, dashboard); optional ads from the Ads Manager (https://fig-promo.vercel.app/ads): pay per tap (auction, second price, $0.30 minimum), daily budget, targeting by distance, days/hours, foods and new vs returning diners, rotating photos, results down to diners who came in; invoiced monthly
- How a deal works: claim (held 24 hours), show the QR code (refreshes every 5 minutes), pay the restaurant directly
- Takeout: order ahead, pay at pickup, no delivery or service fees from FIG
- Privacy: restaurants never see a diner's phone number

- [Home](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/): what FIG is, features, pricing
- [About](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/about): the full story and FAQ
- [Help center](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/help): answers for diners and restaurants
- [FIG is free for restaurants. Here's how we make money](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/how-fig-makes-money): Listing, deals, scans, takeout and chats are free on FIG, with no commission. FIG is paid by restaurants' ads, only when a diner taps, and by the optional FIG Premium.
- [How to find the best restaurant deals in Markham](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/restaurant-deals-markham): A practical guide to eating out for less in Markham, Ontario: when to go, where to look and how to use FIG.
- [Delivery app commissions vs FIG: what restaurants keep](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/delivery-app-commissions-vs-fig): Delivery apps charge restaurants a percentage of every order. FIG charges nothing per diner. Here's how the two compare for a Markham restaurant.
- [7 ways to fill slow hours at your restaurant](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/fill-slow-hours-restaurant): Practical ideas for independent restaurants to bring in diners on quiet afternoons and weeknights, without giving away margin.
- [Student food deals in Markham: eating out on a budget](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/student-food-deals-markham): How high school and university students in Markham can eat out for less: after-school deals, group plans and budget filters.
- [What are flash deals, and how do they work on FIG?](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/flash-deals-explained): Flash deals are short, real-time restaurant deals posted during quiet hours. Here's how to catch them in Markham.
- [Order ahead, pick up, skip the delivery fees](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/takeout-without-delivery-fees): FIG takeout lets you order from a Markham restaurant's menu, watch it get made and pay at pickup, with no delivery or service fees.
- [Why we built FIG](https://fig-promo.vercel.app/blog/why-we-built-fig): Markham has incredible independent restaurants. We wanted a way to find them that's fair to the owners too.
